messages:
maria: Quick sync — Sparkplug Cloud asked for a joint marketplace spotlight + demo. They want a short case study, a 30-min live demo, and a co-authored launch post. timeline: 6 weeks. Who can own the content runbook and lead routing?

ben: I can own the launch post + hero messaging. Will need the customer quote and perf numbers from eng. Proposed webinar date window: 6/10–6/17.

jess: I'll lead the demo runbook. Can we scope what the demo must show? Suggested checklist: 1) quick architecture slide 2) 10-min live demo of API + latency/cost slide 3) customer testimonial 4) CTA to marketplace listing.

oliver: +1 to Jess. Also add an optional short benchmark snippet comparing baseline infra vs Redwood Dedicated for latency. Nothing heavy — one slide with median p95.

maria: Great. Ben, please draft messaging and TBD hero quote. Jess, can you sketch the run-of-show and a short runbook snippet we can hand to the customer for rehearsal?

jess: Draft runbook (short):
```
- 00:00 Intro (maria)
- 02:00 Customer/customer quote + value prop (customer rep)
- 05:00 Architecture + how it plugs into Sparkplug (oliver)
- 10:00 Live demo: create session -> stream response -> show latency metrics (jess)
- 20:00 Benchmarks slide + q/a (ben + eng)
- 30:00 CTA -> marketplace listing + lead form
```
We should rehearse twice (internal + with Sparkplug).

ben: Love it. For assets: I'll need screenshots of the console, a short GIF of streaming, and the benchmark slide. Can eng produce a small synthetic test (1k tokens, 4 concurrent users) to get numbers? @sai — can you help with the perf numbers and a tiny script?

sai: Yep — I can run the synthetic. Will post results by EOD Friday. I'll produce p50/p95 + cost per 1k tokens.

maria: Lead routing note — Sparkplug wants leads routed to their MDR + our AE queue depending on intent. Proposed mapping: marketplace_list -> tag:spk_marketplace, intent:trial -> sales-ae, intent:deploy -> partner-mdr. Also capture utm_campaign=sparkplug_spotlight.

oliver: For the registration form, add a multi-select: 'Deploy timeline' + 'Primary use case'. Helps route automatically. We can add a hidden field lead_source=sparkplug_marketplace.

ben: I'll draft the co-branded launch post & webinar landing copy. Callouts: "Redwood + Sparkplug: predictable inference at cloud scale". Will share a first pass tomorrow.

maria: Promo plan: 2 emails (our list + co-send), 3 social posts, partners newsletter, and syndicate to marketplace. @marketbot can you schedule the initial promo calendar when Ben drops copy?

marketbot: noted: will create calendar item when copy received, and add reminders 2 weeks / 3 days / 1 day prior. :calendar:

jess: One more ops item — demo creds and sample repo. I'll drop a tiny repo link in #devex and give customer access before rehearsals.

maria: Awesome. Action items recap: Ben = draft post + landing copy (due Tue), Sai = perf numbers (EOD Fri), Jess = runbook + repo (EOD Mon), Oliver = benchmark slide + console screenshots (Wed), Marketbot = schedule once copy in. We'll regroup next Wed after perf numbers. Thanks all :rocket:
